section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Search AI Monetization vs. Open-Source / Hyperscaler Commoditization (OpenSearch & pgvector)
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Skeptical sell-side checks (e.g., TD Cowen $85 Hold) argue enterprise GenAI POCs are slow to convert into production consumption and face fierce pricing pressure from AWS OpenSearch, MongoDB Atlas Vector Search, and Postgres pgvector.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Over 37% of Elastic's >$100K ACV customers are already running AI workloads in production, driving record QoQ net-new >$100K customer additions (+80+ in Q1) and +21% cRPO growth. Elastic's DiskBBQ vector compression, Better Binary Quantization, and Jina AI On-Prem models deliver lower TCO at billion-vector scale.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CEO Ash Kulkarni: What proportion of the record Q1/Q2 >$100K ACV customer wins were directly catalyzed by VectorDB / RAG production deployments, and how is ACV expansion trending when customers migrate from POC to Search AI Lake?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Self-Serve Monthly Cloud Drag vs. Sales-Led Subscription Re-Acceleration
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: Flat sequential Monthly Elastic Cloud revenue (~$49M–$50M/quarter, +6% YoY) masks sluggish SMB/self-serve developer expansion and drags headline total revenue growth down to ~15%.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Sales-led subscription (83%+ of total revenue) is compounding at +18% YoY and accelerating via multi-year enterprise platform consolidation across Observability (Deductive AI + native PromQL) and Security (SIEM displacement + Alert Zero), rendering self-serve monthly noise increasingly irrelevant to intrinsic FCF.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: CFO: Given Sales-Led Subscription is outpacing Monthly Elastic Cloud by >10 percentage points, when does Elastic Cloud Serverless adoption inflect self-serve consumption back into double-digit YoY growth?

section_4b_pre_print_debates.title: Valuation Dislocation (4.2x EV/Sales, 20.5x Fwd P/E) vs. Gross Margin Pressure from Serverless GPU Hosting
section_4b_pre_print_debates.consensus_view: GAAP Subscription Cost of Revenue jumped to $91.9M in Q1 FY27 (up from $69.4M YoY), compressing GAAP gross margin from 76.7% to 74.5% due to cloud infrastructure and GPU inference investments.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.variant_perception: Even after accounting for cloud hosting investments, ESTC generated $132M OCF and $143M adjusted FCF in Q1 alone (~30% margin) and repurchased $40M of stock under its $500M buyback. At 20.5x forward P/E vs 38x–52x for MDB/DDOG, any clean Q3 guide >$520M triggers violent multiple re-rating.
section_4b_pre_print_debates.call_focus_question: Management: Should investors expect GAAP subscription gross margins to stabilize around 74.5%–75.5% as Elastic Cloud Serverless and Elastic Inference Service (EIS) scale, and how aggressively will you deploy the remaining $500M buyback near $80/share?
